title: Melania Trump’s Busy Schedule: A New Show, a Foster-Care Bill and Reading Executive Orders
summary: In a burst of activity this week, the enigmatic first lady told Americans what she has been up to after a quiet summer. Her activities have included filming a new documentary series about her life.
